public.hero.title: Gawo la mbewu lowerengedwa ndi nyengo yomwe yachitika
public.hero.intro: Mecropolis imasonkhanitsa heat units (GDD) kuchokera ku kutentha kolembedwa ndi Open-Meteo kuyambira pobzala. Nyengo iliyonse ya ulimi ku Western Cape imapita ku gawo lotsatira chiwerengerochi chikafika pa malire a mbewuyo.

public.how.title: Kuyambira tsiku lobzala mpaka gawo la mbewu
public.how.lead: Nthawi zambiri gawo la mbewu limalembedwa ndi munthu, choncho limakhala lolondola mpaka pa nthawi yomwe linasinthidwa komaliza. Pano limawerengedwa kuchokera ku nyengo yolembedwa, ndipo kusintha kulikonse kumasunga umboni wake.
public.step.1.title: Lembani zomwe mlimi akudziwa
public.step.1.body: Mafamu, minda, mbewu ndi masiku obzala zimasungidwa mu Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Tengani nyengo yomwe yachitika
public.step.2.body: Kutentha kwa tsiku lililonse pa malo a mundawo kumachokera ku mbiri ya Open-Meteo, kuyambira pobzala mpaka lero.
public.step.3.title: Sonkhanitsani heat units
public.step.3.body: Heat units (GDD) zimasonkhanitsidwa potsatira chitsanzo cha mbewuyo. Zikafika pa malire, dongosolo limapititsa nyengo ya ulimi ku gawo lotsatira ndi kulemba chifukwa chake.
public.models.title: Zitsanzo za mbewu zomwe zikugwiritsidwa ntchito
public.models.lead: Heat units zofunika kuti mbewu zikhwime ndi kutentha. Ziwerengerozi zalembedwa ndi anthu ndipo zilibe magwero pano.
public.live.title: Nyengo pa famu yoyesera ya Swartland
public.live.lead: Ziwerengero zochokera ku magwero a anthu onse, zikusinthidwa mphindi 30 zilizonse.
public.yields.title: Miyezo yofalitsidwa ya zokolola
public.honesty.title: Mmene deta imagwiritsidwira ntchito
public.honesty.1.title: Woyendetsa ndiye amalemba zokolola
public.honesty.1.body: Mpaka wogwiritsa ntchito alembe zokolola, pulogalamuyi imasonyeza “Sizinalembedwe”.
public.honesty.2.title: Ziwerengero zoyerekezera zimasungidwa padera
public.honesty.2.body: Ziwerengero za m'chigawo ndi za dziko zimasungidwa m'makalata awo, limodzi ndi kumene zachokera ndi muyeso wake. Siziyerekezedwa ndi zokolola za m'munda.
public.honesty.3.title: Zolemba za tizirombo ndi za m'chigawo
public.honesty.3.body: Zolemba za GBIF zimasonyeza kumene tizirombo tinaonedwa mkati mwa 100 km, komanso mtunda wake.
public.honesty.4.title: Nyengo ndi yaposachedwa
public.honesty.4.body: Kutentha kumatengedwa ku nkhokwe ya Open-Meteo nthawi imene mwapempha.
public.open.title: Tsegulani nyengo yolima
public.open.body: Lowani pa bolodi loyesera kuti muone mzere wa GDD wa nyengo yolima ndi umboni wa gawo lake.

public.yield.lead: Magulu atatuwa amayeza zinthu zosiyana pa madera osiyana, choncho sangayerekezedwe wina ndi mnzake kapena ndi munda uliwonse.
public.about.title: Za pulogalamuyi
public.about.heading: Za Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis ndi pulogalamu yotsatira minda ndi mbewu pafamu ya ku Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Chifukwa chake ilipo
public.about.why.body: Magawo a mbewu amachedwa kusinthidwa ndipo zokolola zimalembedwa pokumbukira. Mecropolis imawerengera gawo la mbewu pogwiritsa ntchito nyengo yolembedwa. Nambala iliyonse imachokera kwa wogwiritsa ntchito kapena ku gwero la anthu lotchulidwa.
public.about.design.title: Kapangidwe
public.about.design.1.body: Masiku a kutentha kothandiza mbewu (GDD) amaunjikana kuyambira tsiku lobzala pogwiritsa ntchito nkhokwe ya Open-Meteo. Kusintha kulikonse kwa gawo kumasunga umboni wake: tsiku limene kunayamba kugwira ntchito, GDD yonse ndi zimene kunawerengeredwa kuchokera.
public.about.design.2.body: Gawo lotsatira lokonzekera kukolola limatchedwa kukhwima chifukwa cha kutentha, popeza palibe chochitika chokolola chimene chalembedwa.
public.about.design.4.body: Zimasungidwa m'makalata awo limodzi ndi gwero, muyeso ndi chilolezo.
public.about.stack.title: Zipangizo zamapulogalamu
public.about.stack.body: Pulogalamu ya tsamba limodzi ya Vite ndi React 19 pa Cloudflare Pages. Msakatuli amawerenga mwachindunji deta ya Sanity yopezeka kwa anthu pogwiritsa ntchito GROQ ndi chomvetsera zosintha nthawi yomweyo. Zolemba ndi deta ya makiyi zimadutsa mu Cloudflare Pages Functions, zomwe zimayang'ana cookie ya gawo yosainidwa. Zod imayang'ana deta polowa ndi potuluka, Vitest imayesa pulogalamu ndipo Tailwind 4 imakongoletsa maonekedwe.
public.about.limits.title: Zofooka zodziwika
public.about.limits.1: Manambala a mtundu wa mbewu (kutentha koyambira, kutentha kofunika kuti imere ndi kukhwima) analembedwa pamanja ndipo alibe magwero panopa.
public.about.limits.2: Chiwerengero choyerekezera cha lupin chimachokera ku HarvestStat cha 2000 mpaka 2007 chokha, ndipo kuyambitsa deta sikunapeze makalata a chiwerengero cha lupin.
public.about.limits.3: Deta ya tizirombo ndi zolemba za GBIF za pafupi ndi famu. Zimasonyeza kumene mtundu wina unalembedwa pafupi ndi famu.
public.about.limits.4: Chitsanzochi chili ndi akaunti imodzi yolowera ya onse komanso choletsa kuchuluka kwa zopempha chosungidwa m'maganizo a seva. Kulowa kumabisa masamba a bolodi koma sikuteteza deta: aliyense angawerenge deta. Koma kumateteza zolemba zonse.

docs.stages.title: Kayendedwe ka magawo
docs.stages.intro: Nyengo zolima zimapita patsogolo m'magawo asanu ndi limodzi:
docs.stages.guards: Kusintha gawo kulikonse kuli ndi zofunika zake. Gawo lobzalidwa limafuna deti lobzala ndi mbewu; gawo lokula limafuna GDD yofunika kuti mbewu imere; lokonzekera kukolola limafuna 90% ya GDD yofunika kuti ikhwime; kukhwima chifukwa cha kutentha kumafuna kufika pa GDD yokhwimira; kuunikanso kumafuna chithunzi cha nyengo ya nyengo yolimayo ndi chiwerengero choyerekezera chotsimikizika. Zofunika za GDD zimafunanso deta ya kutentha ya masiku osachepera 90% a nthawiyo, ndipo kusintha kokhala ndi deti loyamba m'tsogolo kumaletsedwa.

docs.seed.title: Kuyika deta yoyambira
docs.seed.body: {0} imalemba famu yoyesera, minda, mbewu ndi nyengo mu deta yomwe mwasankha, kenako imagwirizanitsa ziwerengero za m'dera. Imalowa m'malo mwa famu, minda ndi mbewu, choncho iyendetseni pa deta yanu yokha.
guide.title: Mmene mungagwiritsire ntchito Mecropolis
guide.lead: Malangizo achidule m’mawu osavuta. Akufotokoza ntchito ya pulogalamuyi, amene angaigwiritse ntchito ndi ntchito ya gawo lililonse.
guide.what.title: Mecropolis ndi chiyani
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis imatsata minda ndi mbewu za pa famu. Imawerengera mmene mbewu ilili pa kukula powonjezera kutentha komwe yalandira kuchokera pamene inabzalidwa. Imaonetsanso nyengo, nthaka ndi tizirombo ta pafupi ndi famu yanu pamalo amodzi.
guide.what.p2: Inapangidwira mafamu a ku Western Cape ku South Africa, koma imagwiranso ntchito pa famu iliyonse, dera lililonse ndi nyengo iliyonse yolima.
guide.who.title: Ndi ya ndani
guide.who.p1: Ndi ya munthu wosamalira minda, monga mlimi, woyang'anira famu kapena mlangizi wa alimi.
guide.who.p2: Simufunika kudziwa za makompyuta kapena sayansi ya nyengo. Ngati mungatsegule webusaiti, mungagwiritse ntchito Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Chifukwa chogwiritsira ntchito
guide.why.1: Mungaone msanga mbewu zomwe zangobzalidwa, zomwe zikukula ndi zomwe zatsala pang'ono kukolola.
guide.why.2: Simufunika kusintha nokha za munda uliwonse. Pulogalamuyi imapititsa mbewu patsogolo yokha nyengo ikasonyeza kuti nthawi yakwana.
guide.why.3: Imakuchenjezani za chisanu ndi kutentha kwa masiku akubwerawa, komanso tizirombo toonedwa pafupi ndi famu yanu.
guide.why.4: Zonse zolembedwa za munda, monga kupopera mankhwala, tizilombo tomwe munaona kapena cholemba, zimasungidwa pamalo amodzi ndi tsiku lake kuti mudzazionenso.
guide.why.5: Nambala iliyonse imaonetsa kumene yachokera, kuti mudziwe yodalirika.
guide.heat.title: Mmene pulogalamu imadziwira kukula kwa mbewu
guide.heat.p1: Mbewu zimakula msanga kukatentha, ndipo pang'onopang'ono kukazizira. Tsiku lililonse Mecropolis imawerengera kutenthaku ngati mayunitsi a kutentha, omwe asayansi amati growing degree days kapena GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Tsiku lililonse imatenga pakati pa kutentha kwakukulu ndi kochepa, kenako imachotsapo kutentha kumene mbewu imasiya kukula. Chotsalacho ndi mayunitsi a kutentha a tsikulo. Tsiku lozizira silionjezera chilichonse.
guide.heat.p3: Mbewu iliyonse imafunika mayunitsi enaake a kutentha kuti ikhwime. Chiwerengero kuchokera pobzala chikamayandikira pamenepo, mbewuyo imapita ku gawo lotsatira.
guide.heat.p4: Kutenthaku kumachokera ku Open-Meteo, ntchito yaulere yosunga nyengo ya malo onse padziko lapansi.
guide.stages.title: Magawo asanu ndi limodzi
guide.stages.intro: Mbewu iliyonse m'munda uliwonse imadutsa magawowa motsatira dongosololi.
guide.stages.planning: Nyengo yolima yakonzedwa, koma mbewu sinabzalidwebe.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Mbewu yasonkhanitsa kutentha kochuluka komwe ikufunika, choncho ndi nthawi yokonzekera kukolola.
guide.stages.harvested: Mbewu yasonkhanitsa kutentha konse komwe ikufunika, choncho iyenera kukhala yakonzeka. Inu nokha mungatsimikize ngati yakololedwadi, choncho pulogalamuyi imati yakhwima chifukwa cha kutentha.
guide.stages.review: Nyengo yolima yatha ndipo mungaone mmene inayendera.
guide.stages.p2: Pulogalamuyi imayang'ana mbewu iliyonse usiku uliwonse komanso munthu akawonjezera zomwe waona kapena ntchito yomwe wachita. Mungadinenso Reconcile now pa nyengo yolima kuti iyang'ane nthawi yomweyo.
guide.start.title: Poyambira
guide.start.1: Tsegulani tsamba loyamba. Mungaone mapu a nyengo, nthaka, tizirombo ndi zokolola za famu yoyesera popanda kulowa mu akaunti.
guide.start.2: Dinani Sign in pamwamba ndipo gwiritsani ntchito akaunti yoyesera yomwe munapatsidwa.
guide.start.3: Sankhani famu. Izi zimatsegula tsamba lalikulu la famuyo.
guide.start.4: Dinani nyengo yolima kuti muone zonse za mbewu imeneyo m'munda umenewo.
guide.start.5: Gwiritsani ntchito bokosi la chinenero pamwamba pa tsamba lililonse kuti musinthe chinenero. Pulogalamuyi idzakumbukira zomwe mwasankha mukadzabweranso.
guide.home.title: Tsamba loyamba
guide.home.p1: Tsamba loyamba lili ndi mapu a dera okhala ndi mitundu yosonyeza kutentha komwe nthaka yalandira nyengo ino. Limaonetsanso nyengo ya lero ndi masiku akubwerawa, nthaka ya famu yoyesera, tizirombo toonedwa pafupi posachedwa ndi zokolola zapakati za m'dera. Simufunika kulowa mu akaunti kuti muone izi.
guide.dashboard.title: Tsamba lalikulu la famu
guide.dashboard.intro: Tsamba lalikulu limaonetsa famu imodzi. Magawo ake ali motere kuchokera pamwamba mpaka pansi. Bokosi la famu pamwamba limakulolani kupita ku famu ina.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Chidule cha famu
guide.dashboard.summary: Chiwerengero cha minda ndi mahekitala a famu, nyengo zolima zomwe zikuyenda ndi mbewu zomwe zakonzeka.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Zofunika kusamalira
guide.dashboard.alerts: Machenjezo achidule monga chisanu kapena kutentha komwe kukubwera, mbewu yokonzeka, nyengo yolima yomwe sinayambe pa nthawi yake kapena tizirombo toonedwa pafupi ndi munda. Chenjezo lililonse limanena chomwe chayambitsa.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Mmene zinthu zilili pa famu
guide.dashboard.conditions: Nyengo ya lero, nyengo yomwe ikubwera, nthaka ndi tizirombo ta pafupi ndi famuyi.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Kupita patsogolo kwa nyengo yolima
guide.dashboard.progress: Khadi la mbewu iliyonse losonyeza kuchuluka kwa kutentha komwe yasonkhanitsa. Mungayerekezere minda moyandikana ndi kutsitsa mndandandawo ngati fayilo ya spreadsheet (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Minda
guide.dashboard.fields: Munda uliwonse wa pa famu, kukula kwake, nthaka yake ndi mbewu zake.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Fufuzani zolembedwa
guide.dashboard.search: Lembani zomwe mukufuna m'mawu wamba, monga nsabwe za m'masamba pa tirigu. Imapeza zomwe zinaonedwa ndi ntchito zomwe zikutanthauza chimodzimodzi, ngakhale zinalembedwa ndi mawu ena.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Malangizo
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Ntchito zomwe akupangira m'munda, monga kupopera mankhwala kapena kuthira feteleza. Mungavomereze kapena kukana iliyonse, ndipo mulembe kuti yatha mukamaliza.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Zomwe zachitika posachedwa
guide.dashboard.activity: Mndandanda wa nthawi imene mbewu iliyonse inapita ku gawo latsopano.
guide.season.title: Tsamba la nyengo yolima
guide.season.intro: Nyengo yolima ndi mbewu imodzi m'munda umodzi m'chaka chimodzi. Tsamba lake lili ndi zonse zokhudza nyengoyo.
guide.season.top.label: Pamwamba pa tsamba
guide.season.top: Mbewu, munda, tsiku lobzala, nthawi yokolola yomwe ikuyembekezeka ndi zokolola mukazilemba.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Magawo a mbewu
guide.season.pipeline: Magawo asanu ndi limodzi, ndipo gawo la panopa lalembedwa. Dinani Reconcile now kuti muone nthawi yomweyo ngati mbewu iyenera kupita patsogolo.
guide.season.readiness.label: Kukonzeka kusankha zochita
guide.season.readiness: Mndandanda wa zomwe pulogalamu imafunika isanapititse mbewu patsogolo, monga tsiku lobzala ndi deta yokwanira ya nyengo. Chilichonse chimati Pass, Warning kapena Blocked. Chotsekedwa chimakuuzani chomwe chikusowa.
guide.season.evidence.label: Umboni
guide.season.evidence: Zolembedwa zomwe pulogalamu inagwiritsa ntchito posankha zochita, kuti muzitsimikize.
guide.season.propose.label: Perekani lingaliro la ntchito
guide.season.propose: Perekani lingaliro la ntchito ya m'mundawu limodzi ndi umboni wa nyengo yolima. Limakhala ngati chikalata choyembekezera mpaka wina alivomereze pa tsamba lalikulu.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Tchati cha mayunitsi a kutentha omwe akuwonjezeka kuchokera pobzala, chokhala ndi mzere wa kutentha konse komwe mbewu imafunika.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Bwanji ngati?
guide.season.whatIf: Yesani tsiku lobzala loyambirira kapena lochedwa, kapena nyengo yotentha kapena yozizira, ndipo muone mmene mayunitsi a kutentha angasinthire. Palibe chomwe chimasungidwa.
guide.season.summary.label: Chidule cha nyengo yolima
guide.season.summary: Chidule cha zolembedwa za nyengo yolima chopangidwa ndi AI. Chigwiritseni ntchito ngati chothandiza, ndipo onani zolembedwa ngati china chake chikuoneka cholakwika.
guide.season.notes.label: Zolemba za nyengo yolima
guide.season.notes: Zolemba za nyengo yolima zokhala ndi masiku. Mungawonjezere, kusintha ndi kufufuta, komanso kubwezeretsa mtundu wakale wa cholemba.
guide.season.files.label: Chithunzi cha munda ndi lipoti la kuyezetsa nthaka
guide.season.files: Kwezani chithunzi cha munda ndi PDF ya kuyezetsa nthaka yochokera ku labotale.
guide.season.log.label: Buku la munda
guide.season.log: Zomwe munaona m'munda ndi zomwe munachita, monga kupopera mankhwala ndi kulemba mankhwala ake komanso mlingo wake.
guide.season.history.label: Mbiri ya zosintha
guide.season.history: Kusintha kulikonse kosungidwa pa nyengo yolimayi ndi tsiku lake.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Zokolola zoyerekezera za m'dera
guide.season.benchmark: Zokolola zapakati za m'dera zochokera ku ziwerengero za anthu onse. Ndi zoyerekezera chabe, osati zokolola za munda wanu.
guide.season.pests.label: Tizirombo toonedwa m'dera
guide.season.pests: Tizirombo tonenedwa pafupi ndi munda pa GBIF, nkhokwe ya anthu onse ya zomwe zaonedwa. Dinani Fetch sightings kuti mutenge zaposachedwa.
guide.sources.title: Kumene manambala amachokera
guide.sources.weather: Nyengo imachokera ku Open-Meteo, ya lero, masiku akubwerawa ndi masiku apitawo.
guide.sources.soil: Deta ya nthaka imachokera ku SoilGrids, mapu a nthaka padziko lonse.
guide.sources.pests: Tizirombo toonedwa timachokera ku GBIF, nkhokwe ya anthu onse ya zomwe zaonedwa.
guide.sources.yields: Zokolola za m'dera zimachokera ku USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa ndi World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Zina zonse, monga zolemba, ntchito za m'munda ndi zokolola zanu, ndi zomwe inu kapena gulu lanu munalemba.
guide.limits.title: Zomwe singachite
guide.limits.model: Mayunitsi a kutentha omwe mbewu iliyonse imafunika ndi kuyerekezera kwathu ndipo sanayesedwe m'munda. Agwiritseni ntchito ngati malangizo, koma khulupirirani zomwe mukuona m'munda wanu.
guide.limits.maturity: Kukhwima mwa kutentha kumatanthauza kuti nyengo ikusonyeza kuti mbewu yakonzeka. Koma inu nokha ndi amene mungadziwe ngati yakonzekadi.
guide.limits.translation: Mawu omasulirawa analembedwa ndi AI. Ayenera kukhala osavuta kumva, koma munthu wolankhula chinenerochi sanayang'ane chinenero chilichonse.
guide.limits.demo: Chitsanzochi ndi cha aliyense, choncho musalembemo zachinsinsi.
